name: union_extract
description: Extract the value of the named member from the union. NULL if the value belongs to another member (the member of a value is the first member whose type matches the value)

name: union_tag
description: Deprecated: retrieve the member of the union value as an ENUM. Tags are not stored, the member is the first member whose type matches the value

name: union_value
description: Create a single member UNION containing the argument value. The tag of the value will be the bound variable name
